# Tacet Documentation (Full)

## Overview
Tacet is an open-source, private, terminal-native AI personal assistant written in Rust. It provides human-like assistant capabilities directly inside your terminal without sending prompt data or personal information to third-party cloud APIs.

## Architecture & Privacy Model
- **Local Model Engine**: Uses high-efficiency GGML/GGUF local models quantized for consumer hardware.
- **Local Database & Vector Memory**: SQLite/embedded storage on user's disk for persistent notes and memory.
- **Sandboxed Tool Execution**: File and document generation restricted to local workspace directories with interactive receipt prompts.

## Command Reference
- `tacet chat`: Start an interactive conversational session.
- `tacet model list`: List locally downloaded models.
- `tacet model download <name>`: Fetch supported GGUF model weights.
- `tacet config`: Interactive configuration menu.
